title: 543. Largest Palindrome Product

examples.explanation: 9 is the largest palindromic single-digit product.

hints: Only even-length palindromes need checking for n > 1; build them from the top half downward.
For each candidate, test divisors from the top down and stop once divisor squared drops below it.
The n = 8 palindrome exceeds 53-bit precision, so reduce modulo 1337 without forming the full product in float.
